composition.note: Ablations reuse measured forward results but charge full forward costs to every policy. Generalist plus design is an equally funded ordinary-tool competitor. One factorization per distinct matrix; factor reuse is valid within each solve and is never prohibited.

environment.provenance: Researcher-constructed learning system; numeric bases are updated by executed experience.

selection.selection_rule: Maximum exact accepted count, raw accepted count, lowest mean raw error, then rank. Primary ordinary baseline minimizes development mean full runtime among direct, ILU-GMRES, spectral-PCG.
